title: A calm multiplayer meditation space in the browser, looking for alpha testers - FREE, NO SIGNUPS, NO INSTALL 🧘
author: AvatarWuji
selftext:
I’m building **ZenOasis**: a quiet, shared place online where you can sit, practise breath exercises, and just *be*, alongside other people, without chat, likes or noise.

The whole thing was built with Claude Code as my dev partner: the code, the Three.js scenes, the shaders, the low-poly art (all procedural, no image generation) and the realtime server on Cloudflare. I did the creative direction and design, and gave a *lot* of feedback.

**What’s in the alpha:**

* 🌊 **Four Locations:** a moon-shaped cove at sunset, a forest waterfall, a temple on a mountain peak in a lightning storm, and a floating Gateway with a giant bronze statue of Shiva Nataraja. Each comes with real nature sounds that you can turn up/down/off to create the environment that's just right for you.
* 👥 **Real people, sharing the space.** You see other visitors walk, sit and bow, but there’s no text chat by design
* 🌬️ **A breathing guide app:** box breathing, 4-7-8 and more, or \*build your own breath exercises\*. The visual guide traces your breath, so it's easy to follow along, and includes an optional bell and chimes
* 🕯️ **One ritual per place:** You can interact with the scene - stack stones at the Cove, plant flowers at the Waterfall, light candles before the Buddha at the Temple. They’re shared, public actions, so everyone sees what you leave
* 🥚 **Easter eggs:** Each location contains some unexpected surprises if you explore a little - a whale, a temple cat, a summit lightning strike… I’ll let you find the rest :)

**No sign-up, no install, works in your browser:**

  
👉 [**https://zenoasis.pages.dev**](https://zenoasis.pages.dev)



**What I’d love from you:** spend 5–10 minutes there, then tell me honestly: did it feel calming? What broke? What features would you add? How would you like to see it evolve?   
  
There’s a feedback button in the bottom-right corner of the app, a feedback form that triggers after 5 minutes of play, or, if you like, you can just reply with feedback/thoughts here in the comments.  
  
I've got lots of ideas about where I want to take this project, but I wanted to let users give direction too, so please be liberal with your feedback and suggestions!

Happy to answer questions about the build, the workflow, the stack (Three.js + Cloudflare Durable Objects), the project vision, or anything else for that matter :)
